tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full text search over The Student Life city guides, blog guides for international and Erasmus students, the FAQ, pricing and the privacy, terms and refund policies. Returns ids, titles, links and a snippet; read one with get_doc.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Read one document in full as plain text: a blog guide, a city guide, the FAQ, pricing or a policy. Pass the id from search_docs (e.g. "blog/erasmus-2026-guide", "city/berlin", "refund-policy") or its URL.
